modes.label: Auto
modes.summary: Resolve a concrete mode and source-grounded Fast/Architect routing, then assign actual workers.

modes.label: Plan
modes.summary: Delegate planning, criticize the plan and stop before product changes.

modes.label: Build
modes.summary: Use a specialist executor and independent plan/result review for the authorized change.

modes.label: Review
modes.summary: Delegate meaningful inspection and report findings without implementing repairs.

modes.label: Loop
modes.summary: Repeat independent review, checklist execution and fresh review until acceptance or a genuine blocker.
